positions.name: MeridianGateDefinition
positions.frame: what does the Meridian deployment gate consist of — its requirement, scope, and ownership?
positions.why: src-1 and src-3 state the identical signed-manifest requirement twice — once as a prose directive, once as a bulleted declarative record — and src-4 and src-5 extend that same gate object with its environmental scope and its accountable owner. All four are performed in the same settled, decision-register conviction (authority-ranking mandate, formal bolded-label protocol framing) and are true because of the policy facts they each state, not because of any argument for them. src-2, the causal justification citing the prior incidents, sits at a different conviction level (claim rather than decision) and stands apart as the sole rationale statement rather than a further fact about the gate's shape.
